entries.name: STWM_API_KEY
entries.description: The Search The Watch Market Business API key, sent as a Bearer token to read prices, days to sell and price history. It goes only to Search The Watch Market.
howToGet: The store subscribes to a Business API plan on searchthewatchmarket.com. Once approved, the key appears under API Access in the account, as the vendor's API reference describes.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: STWM_REFERENCES
entries.description: The watch references or model names the store follows, comma or newline separated, up to 200.
howToGet: List the references the store buys, sells or takes in trade most often. A manufacturer reference number matches more reliably than a name.
